ui.notes: twistForKeys(keys, ui, level) in demo/js/sim/commands.js: keys is a Set of held KeyboardEvent.code values (single letters such as 'w' also work). W/S walk forward/backward at the selected level's speed, A/D turn the body left/right (also while walking backward), A or D alone turns in place, opposite keys cancel, no key stands. Digit1-5 pick a level, Q/E step it down/up, Shift held uses the fast level. levels[*].actions[*].twist equals a library clip label exactly (twist = [vx m/s, vy m/s, wz rad/s], wz > 0 turns left).
